title: PIA-PINK Immunoassay for Poly-Histidine Tagged Proteins
author: Katja Werner

steps.title: Transfer Protein Sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the protein sample onto an immunoassay membrane using one of the following methods: Western Blot, Dot Blot, Slot Blot, or a protein-protein interaction assay (membrane-based ELISA).

steps.title: Equilibrate Kit
steps.instruction: Remove the PIA-PINK-Kit from the refrigerator and allow it to equilibrate to room temperature.

steps.title: Block Binding Sites
steps.instruction: Block remaining binding sites and wash out excess protein using PIA-PINK-BLOCK solution.

substeps.instruction: Place the membrane into a clean tray of suitable size.
Cover the membrane with PIA-PINK-BLOCK solution.

steps.title: Perform Immunostaining
steps.instruction: Stain the membrane using PIA-PINK-HIS staining solution to detect poly-histidine tagged proteins.

substeps.instruction: Discard the solution from the final blocking/washing step.
Cover the membrane with PIA-PINK-HIS staining solution.
Shake the membrane until the positive control sample exhibits a sufficiently strong pink-red signal.
Remove the membrane from the staining solution to stop the process.

steps.title: Analyze and Store Results
steps.instruction: Process the membrane for imaging and long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Dry the membrane to enhance the signal-to-noise ratio before taking pictures.
Analyze signal intensity using image quantification software.
Store the membrane in a lab book, securing it with clear tape.
